content.short: Craftt tokenizes asset-backed consumer finance, giving investors access to real-world yield.
content.description: Craftt brings asset-backed finance on-chain, connecting institutional and individual investors with tokenized real-world asset yield while giving fintech lenders access to financing. Its Craftt Pass runs as a mini app inside World App, listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: Craftt tokenizes asset-backed consumer finance for real-world yield, with a World App mini app.
